    w=csv.writer(h);w.writerow(['Week','Team','Team Name','Player','Pos','NFL','Slot','Pts','Proj','Score','Opp'])

        m=D['meta'][r['Team Name']];w.writerow([3,int(r['Team']),r['Team Name'],r['Player'],r['Pos'],r['NFL'],r['Slot'],'' if r.get('Pts') is None else r['Pts'],'' if r.get('Proj') is None else r['Proj'],m['score'],m['opp']])

srows=list(csv.DictReader(open('standings.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig')))
for r in srows:
    m=D['meta'].get(r['Team Name'])
    if m and m.get('rec'): r['Record']=m['rec'][0];r['Rank']=m['rec'][1]
